step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows two primary flows: a redirection path for end users scanning QR/NFC links, and an administration/analytics flow. In the redirection flow, Users request short URLs via CloudFront, which triggers Lambda@Edge to query DynamoDB for destination URLs. CloudFront logs are saved to an S3 bucket, processed by a Lambda function, streamed via Kinesis Data Firehose, and stored in a second S3 bucket. In the admin flow, Admins interact via API Gateway and Lambda, which manages permissions in Aurora RDS, updates short URLs in DynamoDB, and queries analytics using Athena. AWS Glue organizes and optimizes data stored in S3 for Athena queries.
